2544.short_description: This 30 lb bag of Himalayan Red Rock Salt is for beef cattle and suits all breeds. Unrefined rock salt for free-choice feeding: it supplies sodium and chloride, and it is not a trace-mineral supplement.
2544.description:
This 30 lb bag of Himalayan Red Rock Salt is for beef cattle and suits all breeds. It is unrefined rock salt, sold for free-choice feeding in the pasture.

Salt supplies sodium and chloride, the two nutrients a ration has to keep supplying every day, and sodium chloride is what cattle need in the largest quantity. Free-choice salt is how most operations provide it. Rock salt is dense, so a block or lump keeps its shape outdoors for a good while, and animals take what they need.

Salt is not a trace-mineral supplement. It does not supply balanced copper, zinc, manganese, selenium, iodine or cobalt, and offering salt is not a substitute for a mineral program matched to your forage. A forage test is where that program starts.

Sold by weight; compare the price per pound with your current source.

2543.short_description: Himalayan Pink Salt Licks for Horses, sold in two weight options. The salt supplies sodium and chloride, which horses need in the ration; it is not a trace-mineral supplement.
2543.description:
Himalayan natural licking salt for horses, also sold as animal feed salt in coarse grains and lumps. Available in two weight options, 2 lbs and 6 lbs.

Horses take salt free-choice. The salt itself supplies sodium and chloride, the two nutrients a ration must keep supplying every day. Rock salt is dense, so a block holds together outdoors and lasts longer when it is kept off the ground and out of standing rain.

Salt is not a trace-mineral supplement. Copper, zinc, manganese, selenium, iodine and cobalt come from a mineral product chosen for your forage and your veterinarian's or nutritionist's advice — not from a salt lick, and not from the amount of colour in the block.

Sold by weight, shipped from our Houston warehouse.

2543.yoast_title: 2 lb Himalayan Pink Salt Licks for Horses | Himalayan Koh

2539.short_description: This 45 lb bag of Himalayan pink salt is for livestock, including horses and cattle. It comes in three grain sizes and can be offered free-choice or mixed into feed. It supplies sodium and chloride, and it is not a trace-mineral supplement.
2539.description:
This 45 lb bag of Himalayan pink salt is for livestock, including horses and cattle. It comes in three grain sizes: offer it free-choice, or mix it into feed.

Pink rock salt is sodium chloride with naturally occurring trace elements from its deposit, which is where the colour comes from. Those trace amounts are not a mineral program. Salt does not supply copper, zinc, manganese, selenium, iodine or cobalt in the balanced amounts a herd needs, and offering it is not a substitute for a mineral supplement chosen from a forage test.

Livestock need two things offered separately and free-choice: salt, and a mineral product matched to their ration. This listing is the salt half.

Sold by weight from our Houston warehouse.
2539.yoast_metadesc: 45 lb bag of Himalayan pink salt for livestock, in three grain sizes. Supplies sodium and chloride; not a trace-mineral supplement.
2539.yoast_title: 45 lb Himalayan Pink Salt for Livestock | Himalayan Koh

2536.short_description: Himalayan Pink Salt pouches for livestock, in a 6 lb size and two grain sizes: fine and coarse. The salt supplies sodium and chloride; it is not a trace-mineral supplement.
2536.description:
Himalayan Koh's Himalayan Pink Salt is offered in 6 lb pouches, in fine or coarse grain.

The fine grain mixes into feed or water. The coarse grain suits free-choice feeding, so animals take what they need and no more. Both are unrefined rock salt, so the colour and grain vary a little from batch to batch — that is what an unrefined salt looks like.

Salt supplies sodium and chloride, the electrolytes a ration must keep supplying daily. It is not a trace-mineral supplement: those nutrients come from a mineral product matched to your forage, offered separately from salt.

2531.short_description: Fine-grain Himalayan pink salt for cooking, hand-mined and unrefined, with a 0.5-1 mm grain. Sold for kitchen use.
2531.description:
Fine-grain Himalayan pink salt for cooking, hand-mined and unrefined, with a 0.5-1 mm grain.

The fine grain dissolves quickly, so it suits everyday seasoning, baking and brining. It is unrefined rock salt, so the pink colour varies slightly between batches.

This is an edible product, sold for kitchen use. Livestock salt — licks, blocks and bulk bags — is a separate product line; the two are not interchangeable.

2526.short_description: Fine-grain Himalayan edible pink salt in a 16 oz jar. Hand-mined and unrefined, for everyday seasoning and cooking.
2526.description:
Fine-grain Himalayan pink salt for cooking, packed in a 16 oz jar. Hand-mined and unrefined, so the grains keep their natural pink colour and dissolve quickly.

Use it for everyday seasoning, at the table or in the pan, and in baking where a fine grain is wanted. Unrefined rock salt varies a little between batches, in colour and in grain — that variation is normal for a product that is not blended.

This is an edible product, sold for kitchen use. Our livestock range is separate.
